questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. We should raise people's awareness about environmental protection. It helps reduce pollution and global warming.
options: A. If we raise people's awareness about environmental protection, it will help reduce pollution and global warming.
B. Unless we raise people's awareness about environmental protection, it helps reduce pollution and global warming.
C. We shouldn't raise people's awareness about environmental protection although it helps reduce pollution and global warming.
D. We raise people's awareness about environmental protection, so it helps increase pollution and global warming.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Hai mệnh đề có quan hệ nguyên nhân - kết quả dùng câu điều kiện loại 1. Dịch nghĩa: Nếu chúng ta nâng cao nhận thức của mọi người về bảo vệ môi trường, điều đó sẽ giúp giảm ô nhiễm và hiện tượng nóng lên toàn cầu.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Cheating is not permitted in exam rooms.
options: A. You may not cheat in exam rooms.
B. You must not cheat in exam rooms.
C. You don't have to cheat in exam rooms.
D. You will not cheat in exam rooms.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “not permitted” = “must not” (cấm làm gì). Dịch nghĩa: Bạn không được phép gian lận trong phòng thi.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It is obligatory to wear the seat belt when we drive.
options: A. We must wear the seat belt when driving.
B. We can't wear the seat belt when driving.
C. We needn't wear the seat belt when driving.
D. We may wear the seat belt when driving.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “It is obligatory to do something” = “must do something” diễn tả nghĩa vụ bắt buộc. Dịch nghĩa: Chúng ta phải thắt dây an toàn khi lái xe.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Bullying also happens on the way to school; as a result, many parents take their children to school every day.
options: A. Many parents take their children to school every day, so bullying also happens on the way there.
B. Many parents take their children to school every day because bullying also happens on the way there.
C. Although bullying happens on the way to school, very few parents take their children to school.
D. Despite being bullied, many parents take their children to school every day to avoid it.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “as a result” (kết quả là) diễn tả nguyên nhân – kết quả, tương đương “because”. Dịch nghĩa: Nhiều phụ huynh đưa con đến trường mỗi ngày vì bắt nạt cũng xảy ra trên đường đến trường.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. We should stand up to negative peer pressure because it badly affects our teenagers.
options: A. Although peer pressure badly affects our teenagers, there is no need to stand up against it.
B. Negative peer pressure badly affects our teenagers; therefore, we should stand up against it.
C. Once we stand up to peer pressure, it will certainly badly affect our teenagers.
D. We should stand up to negative peer pressure; by contrast, it badly affects our teenagers.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “because” chỉ nguyên nhân tương đương “therefore” trong câu ghép nhân - quả. Dịch nghĩa: Áp lực tiêu cực từ bạn bè ảnh hưởng xấu đến thanh thiếu niên, do đó chúng ta nên chống lại nó.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Overpopulation happens as a result of uncontrolled increasing birth rate.
options: A. Uncontrolled increasing birth rate results in overpopulation.
B. Overpopulation leads to uncontrolled increasing birth rate.
C. Uncontrolled increasing birth rate results from overpopulation.
D. Overpopulation results in uncontrolled increasing birth rate.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “as a result of” = “result from” → đảo lại sẽ là “A results in B” (A gây ra B). Dịch nghĩa: Tỷ lệ sinh tăng không kiểm soát dẫn đến tình trạng dân số quá đông.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Poverty causes an increasing crime rate; besides, unemployment also causes an increasing crime rate.
options: A. Poverty causes an increasing crime rate; however, unemployment doesn't.
B. An increasing crime rate causes poverty and unemployment.
C. Both poverty and unemployment result from an increasing crime rate.
D. An increasing crime rate results from poverty and unemployment.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Hai mệnh đề “Poverty causes...” và “unemployment also causes...” đều chỉ nguyên nhân, viết lại với “result from” (là kết quả từ …) Dịch nghĩa: Tỷ lệ tội phạm tăng là kết quả của đói nghèo và thất nghiệp.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Body shaming must be stopped because it is against the law.
options: A. Body shaming is against the law, so it must be stopped.
B. Although body shaming is against the law, it shouldn't be stopped.
C. If body shaming is against the law, it should be stopped.
D. Body shaming must be stopped, so it is against the law.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “because” chuyển sang câu dùng “so” để giữ nguyên quan hệ nguyên nhân - kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Việc miệt thị ngoại hình là trái pháp luật, vì vậy nó phải bị ngăn chặn.
